subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ROCKET is coded as 184311220 and PLUNGE is coded as 161251472. How will TANGLE be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69c93dab49ccbdc9470509f94f2e6693cd32dda1e7eb74c216d6eb57ec252a10.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9301596e1595484dd12796a645b86ffb262c3aec1557e30a044664af931c6e8a.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Consonants represents alphabet positional values.**

**Vowels represents vowel positional order values.**

ROCKET is coded as 184311220.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/184446b1d698e10c648dc00e340c5b28ec022f761998da06f5d931311abde248.png] 

and

PLUNGE is coded as 161251472.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2ac6f183b0f1e4eed51e4922a8227aca4ed40fdc67e223acb210d6b6fb15453.png] 

Similarly,

TANGLE will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b13df74109932c2a396f4a22496a1a81f3534b78a4333fd27d57553936cbe587.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"201147122".**
